title: Idempotency claim does not gate the webhook pipeline (dead defence)
detail: The claim case is a discarded expression: every branch yields Nil and step 2 (find, mark, audit, notify) runs unconditionally. Gleam has no early return. The 'Stand down' never happens, so the claim provides no gating.
recommended_fix: Nest the find, mark, audit, notify block inside the Ok(Returned(_, [_, ..])) branch (or guard the whole block on a successful claim) so duplicate and error claims actually return without proceeding.

title: Duplicated pog.QueryError stringifier (DRY)
detail: This 4-arm body is byte-for-byte identical to notification_dispatch.debug_query_error (notification_dispatch.gleam:704). The code itself acknowledges it: 'mirrors notification_dispatch.debug_query_error — local copy because that one is private'.
recommended_fix: Promote it to one shared helper (e.g. in response_helpers or a pog_helpers module) and call from both, or accept the private-per-module convention and drop the acknowledging comment.
